_comment: Paddock's Codex hooks: merge into ~/.codex/hooks.json (or $CODEX_HOME/hooks.json; see README, 'Sub-agents of Claude Code and Codex'). Replace <HOOKS> with the absolute path of this folder, with forward slashes. Append each group at the END of its event's list: Codex trusts hooks by their position, so inserting or removing a group before another one makes it ask again. Then trust them in Codex with /hooks.
